description: This Java interface defines the 'Voidable' contract for objects in the OpenMRS system that can be voided or invalidated. It includes methods for managing void status, voiding user, void date, and void reason.

methods.name: isVoided
methods.description: Returns whether the object is voided; deprecated in favor of getVoided() method.

methods.name: getVoided
methods.description: Returns true if the object is voided; false otherwise.

methods.name: setVoided
methods.description: Sets the void status of the object.

methods.name: getVoidedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the user who voided the object.

methods.name: setVoidedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who voided the object.

methods.name: getDateVoided
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the object was voided.

methods.name: setDateVoided
methods.description: Sets the date when the object was voided.

methods.name: getVoidReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for voiding the object.

methods.name: setVoidReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for voiding the object.
